notes: Corrected: *thee* in *to save thee* had been folded into מוֹשִׁיעַ's unit. The clause has no object morpheme at all, so rule 44's supplied-object clause makes it its own `added` unit.
כַּאֲשֶׁר fused as elsewhere in the chapter; כָּל הַיָּמִים → *alway* as at 28.33; אֶת takes the *in* of *prosper in* under rule 16.
